ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( AND(TEXT(QCC_Value_Type__c) == "Currency", QCC_Amount__c > 500), AND(TEXT(QCC_Value_Type__c) == "Qantas Points", QCC_Amount__c > 20000), TEXT(QCC_Category__c) == "PO Retain", TEXT(QCC_Category__c) == "Bonus" ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(QCC_Status__c), "Awaiting Approval")), TEXT(QCC_Status__c) == "Approved" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Waivers over $500 or 20,000 PTS or those with "Bonus" / "PO Retail" Category must be submitted for approval.
